About this supplement

This supplement lists the external APIs that must be integrated before Goods.ng can process live transactions, the licensed custody models available for escrow, and the licensed lenders and BNPL orchestrators that can power Goods Flex. It is a companion to the PRD, TAD and FRD.

1. Required API integrations before go-live

The application already has provider interfaces and development mocks for payments, escrow, BNPL, open banking, KYC, SMS, email, object storage, captcha, Meta CAPI and product feeds. The gap is production contracts, credentials, sandbox certification and operational controls.

2. Escrow: licensing and custody options

The key regulatory point
The CBN does not issue a standalone “escrow licence.” Escrow operates under the payments framework. Only deposit-taking institutions — commercial banks, microfinance banks (MFBs), payment service banks (PSBs) and mobile money operators (MMOs) — can hold customer funds. A PSSP or switching licence (Paystack, Flutterwave, Interswitch, Remita) does not permit holding customer funds. Goods.ng must not hold funds itself.
OptionExamplesLicence / custodyAPI fit
Commercial bank escrow / trust accountAccess, Zenith, GTBank, FirstBank, UBA, Stanbic IBTC, Fidelity, Wema, Sterling, ProvidusCBN commercial bank; can hold depositsBespoke corporate escrow API or file-based integration; slower onboarding, strongest institutional comfort.
MFB / PSB custodyRubies MFB (via EscrowPay), FairMoney MFB, 9PSB, Hope PSB, MoMo PSB, SmartCash PSBCBN MFB/PSB; can hold depositsPartner API; often faster to launch than a tier-1 bank.
MMO e-money custodyOPay, PalmPay, Paga, eTranzact, VTNetwork, NowNow, AbegCBN MMO; can hold e-moneyWallet APIs; the escrow structure and release instructions must be contracted.
Escrow-as-a-service APIEscrowPay (Rubies MFB), PayScrow (CBN-licensed DMBs), HarrenaPay (licensed partner bank), Posteering, DailyEscrowCustody via a partner bank/MFB; provider is not a bankREST APIs for create/hold/release/refund plus webhooks; verify custody, licence and commercial terms.
Payment processorsPaystack, Flutterwave, Interswitch, RemitaSwitching / PSSP; cannot hold fundsUse for collection, verification and settlement only; pair with a licensed custodian.
Law-firm escrowD Bar Escrow and similarNo CBN licence; client/trust account at a bankManual, high-value transactions; not API-first.

Recommendation

Shortlist EscrowPay, PayScrow and HarrenaPay for an RFP, plus one commercial bank escrow product. Choose based on custody, API completeness, fees, dispute SLA and launch speed — not brand alone. Use Paystack or Flutterwave as collection rails only; do not describe them as the escrow custodian.

Minimum escrow API contract

  • Create hold: order reference, payment reference, amount, currency, idempotency key.
  • Release: seller amount, platform commission, protection fee, seller payout reference.
  • Refund: full or partial amount, reason, idempotency, provider reference.
  • Status: poll and webhook events for funded, delivered, released, refunded and disputed.
  • Dispute metadata: reason, evidence references, resolution and four-eyes approval.
  • Reconciliation: daily statement or API for balances and transaction-level matching.
  • Security: signed webhooks, IP allow-list, API key rotation and audit logs.

3. BNPL: licensed lenders and orchestrators

The key regulatory point
Goods.ng should not lend directly. The lender must hold the appropriate CBN licence (MFB, finance company, PSB or commercial bank) and appear on the FCCPC digital lending register. Goods.ng can act as a marketplace/agent, but affordability, disclosures, collections and complaint handling must comply with FCCPC rules.
ProviderModel / licenceFit for Goods Flex
KlumpBNPL orchestrator; lending partners include Fidelity Bank, Credit Direct (FCMB), Stanbic IBTC, FirstBank, Renmoney, Wema and PolarisStrong checkout/BNPL API and fastest route to launch; lender is the licensed partner.
CredPalBNPL up to 6 months; credit offered by Dawakin Kudu MFB (CBN-licensed)Merchant API; good retail and e-commerce fit.
ImaliPayBNPL, credit scoring and disbursement APIUseful for embedded credit; verify lender partners and licences.
TendarBNPL checkout and instalment management APIVerify lender partners and commercial terms.
FairMoney MFBCBN-licensed MFB; FCCPC-approved lenderDirect lending partnership; check business API and pricing.
Carbon MFBCBN-licensed MFB; FCCPC-approvedDirect lending partnership; strong digital lending experience.
Renmoney MFBCBN-licensed MFB; FCCPC-approvedDirect lending partnership; consumer credit focus.
BranchFCCPC-approved digital lenderVerify current CBN/state lending licence and API capability.
Page FinancialsFinance companyVerify licence, product terms and API capability.
Credit Direct (FCMB)Licensed lenderDirect or via Klump; strong payroll/consumer lending.
Lendsqr / Indicina / CreditChekLending infrastructure, decisioning and bureau APIs — not lendersBuild or operate a lending programme with a licensed capital provider.
CRC / CreditRegistry / FirstCentralCBN-licensed credit bureausCredit checks, repayment history and affordability inputs.

Recommendation

Launch with Klump or CredPal as the BNPL front end, or contract directly with one or two MFBs/finance companies for Goods Flex. Keep the existing Goods.ng controls: affordability assessment, mandatory guarantor, transparent instalment schedule, one-plan rule and FCCPC-compliant disclosures.

Minimum BNPL API contract

  • Eligibility: customer, amount, tenor, merchant category; decision reason and reference.
  • Offer terms: down payment, financing charge, total payable, instalment schedule, expiry.
  • Acceptance: explicit customer acceptance stored verbatim.
  • Disbursement: funding confirmation and order reference.
  • Repayment: schedule, direct debit/e-mandate, retries, early payoff and default states.
  • Refund/cancellation: cancel the agreement and reverse disbursement or instalments.
  • Webhooks: approved, accepted, disbursed, repaid, overdue, defaulted, cancelled.
  • Reporting: daily reconciliation and portfolio/repayment reports.

SMSTermiiAfrica's Talking/Infobip.

Storage / CDNAWS S3 + CloudFrontCloudflare R2 or DigitalOcean Spaces.

Recommended sequencing

  1. Sign the escrow/custody partner and the BNPL lender; confirm CBN and FCCPC status.
  2. Certify payment collection, refunds and payouts in sandbox; configure webhooks and reconciliation.
  3. Go live with KYC, SMS, email, captcha and S3/CDN in staging.
  4. Complete the Goods Flex open-banking, credit bureau and direct-debit tests.
  5. Deploy production infrastructure, Sentry, alerts, backups and the on-call rota.
  6. Run the staging end-to-end flow, external penetration test and legal sign-off before the first live transaction.

ReconciliationDaily statement or API matches orders, payments, escrow and ledger.Sample file; reconciliation test.
NDPA 2023Data-processing agreement, lawful basis, retention and data-subject requests.DPA; privacy review.
Insurance and uptimeLiability cover, business continuity, uptime SLA and incident notification.Contract; security questionnaire.
SecurityPen test, encryption, access control, incident response and key rotation.Report; remediation plan.
Commercial termsPricing, minimums, termination, exclusivity and volume commitments.Signed contract; finance approval.
Do not launch Protected Checkout without the custodian
A payment gateway is not an escrow provider. Until a licensed custodian is contractually and technically live, do not use the “Protected Checkout” or “escrow-protected” label for transactions where Goods.ng cannot actually hold and release funds through a licensed partner.
